name: Oakhollow Village
description: A peaceful village. No fighting within its walls.

name: Verdant Plains
description: Rolling grassland south of the village, overrun by blobs.

name: Whisperwood
description: An ancient forest west of the village. The trees whisper, and something with feathers and claws answers.

name: Sunscorched Wastes
description: Endless dunes east of the market, where gnolls raid caravans and a cursed tomb lies half-buried.

name: Ashfang Peaks
description: Smoking mountains north of the village. Kobolds serve the red dragon who sleeps on the summit.
